content.rendered:
Just a reminder that tonight is our Ridges Back to School Night! This year we will be hosting an open house event from 6:00-7:30 pm. Families are welcomed to attend at any time during that time block that works for them, and children are welcome, and encouraged to attend with their parents. Families will have a chance to visit classrooms, see our specialist’s spaces, and get some donut treats from our PAC at the front entrance of the school!

Additionally, linked here is a special edition curriculum newsletter that includes the curriculum information and valuable links that were previously shared as a part of our formal presentations at Back to School Nights in the past. If you have questions after looking it over, please just let me know. 

Hope to see you tonight,

Miranda
